public.text: An unresolved placeholder remains in the text: the mapping to WHO's six health system building blocks is said to be provided in 'Annex [X]'. No such annex appears, and Appendices A and B carry no titles in the table of contents or in the body.
public.suggestedRevision: Resolve the cross-reference to the actual annex, and give Appendices A and B titles in both the table of contents and the body. If the building-blocks mapping is not yet drafted, note it as forthcoming rather than referencing a placeholder, since officials will use that mapping to connect the guidance to existing national planning instruments.
